## Outcome
Implement credential-blind local GitHub capability and read operations.

## Scope
Read:
- plugins/codexmax-orchestrator/scripts/github_cli_read.py
- plugins/codexmax-orchestrator/assets/contracts/github-cli-read-v1.md

Write:
- plugins/codexmax-orchestrator/scripts/github_cli_read.py
- plugins/codexmax-orchestrator/assets/contracts/github-cli-read-v1.md
- tests/test_github_cli_read.py

## Non-goals
- GitHub writes
- Credential inspection
- Arbitrary commands

## Acceptance criteria
- Closed credential-blind reads work for the exact repository and emit bounded receipts.

## Validation
- `VAL-T030` — Run GitHub-read, native-interface, release-parity, and exact-repository read checks. → All selected checks pass.

## Dependencies
- T020

## Stop condition
Stop on credential access, shell text, write symbols, or identity ambiguity.

## Orcastrata state
- Work item: `T030`
- GoalBuddy status: `done`
